meaning: Finite one-being interpretations: for each of the four derivations UNLIMITED-IS-OWN-BEING-FROM-RECEPTION, UNLIMITED-DETERMINATIONS-PURE-FROM-RECEPTION, INFINITE-PERFECTION-FROM-RECEPTION and UNLIMITED-ESSE-INFINITE-FROM-OWN-BEING, one model per premise in which the other premises hold and the conclusion fails, and one model in which all premises and the conclusion hold. Satisfiability and omission only; no model is claimed to describe reality.
